role: Semantic visual inference is an observation helper, not the coach and not a source of GOOD/IMPROVE labels.
allowed_questions: Locate visible enemy body/head when classical/template detection is insufficient.
Determine whether a sequence shows a player emerging from cover (peek candidate).
Classify visible cover/escape-route availability only when supported by frames.
Classify remote utility/world effect and whether it visibly affected ally/enemy/self.
Interpret minimap/site entry or rotation context when geometry registry is unavailable, with reduced confidence.

For a selected low-motion keyframe sequence, estimate whether crosshair was already near the visible/semantic corner headline before exposure; output low-confidence factual alignment only, not timing claims unsupported by frames.
forbidden_questions: What should the player have done?
Infer hidden enemy positions not shown by the recording.
Count or infer exposed attack directions from hidden/off-screen enemy possibilities.
Author exposed_directions_count; that field may only come from static map/peek registry.
Use AI Coach labels/rule IDs/coaching output as context for fact extraction.

invocation_policy.budget_exhaustion_action: return unknown/null; do not expand the budget automatically
invocation_policy.session_isolation: Semantic adapter calls are independent API requests/contexts from AI Coach. Do not include evaluation rules, prior GOOD/IMPROVE labels, or coaching text.
